payments.module.name: Payments
payments.module.description: Taking money: payment providers and card readers, one payment for several things at the desk, till sessions, and refunds.
payments.settings.attempts.answer-within: How long to wait for a provider to answer before a payment is marked unknown. Seats are kept while it is unknown, and the provider keeps being asked.
payments.settings.attempts.alert-unknown: Alert about an unknown payment after
When a payment still without an answer appears on the health screen and staff are told.
payments.settings.refunds.self-approve-u: Largest refund one person may approve alone
A refund at or under this amount may be requested and approved by the same person. Nothing means every refund needs two people. A change does not affect refunds already requested.
payments.settings.refunds.window.label: Refunds may be asked for up to
payments.settings.refunds.window.help: How long after a payment a refund may be requested.
payments.settings.sessions.variance-need: Cash difference that needs a second person
When the cash counted at the end of a session differs from what was expected by more than this, a second person must close the session. Applies only when cash is taken.
payments.settings.sessions.default-float: The float suggested when someone opens a till session. Applies only when cash is taken.
payments.settings.sessions.default-space: Where the till opens a session on a device that has not sold anywhere before. Sessions opened with this unset are at an unknown place until someone moves them.
payments.settings.sessions.close-when-qu: How long after its last sale a session closes itself. A session with cash in it stops instead, and waits to be counted.
payments.settings.desk.email-domains.lab: Email providers suggested at the till
payments.settings.desk.email-domains.hel: When a seller types a name into the box for a receipt, the till offers it at each of these, such as "Use sam@gmail.com". Write each as the part after the @.
payments.settings.retention.webhooks.hel: How long a record of each notification from a payment provider is kept. Only its id and type are kept, never its contents.
For a test instance only. A payment provider account in test mode can then take payment for tickets and other sales, which are confirmed and recorded in the ledger as if the money were real. Never turn this on for a theatre selling to the public: anyone could book with a test card.
payments.abilities.provider.manage.label: Add payment providers, pair card readers and switch test mode
payments.abilities.settings.manage.label: Change payments settings
payments.abilities.attempt.attest.label: Record a cash or card machine payment at the desk
payments.abilities.session.open.label: Open and cash up your own till session
payments.abilities.session.view.label: See till sessions and their counts
payments.abilities.session.close-any.lab: Close someone else's till session, or countersign a cash difference
payments.abilities.refund.request.label: Ask for a refund from the Payments screens
payments.abilities.refund.approve.label: Approve or decline a refund someone else asked for
payments.abilities.attempt.reconcile.lab: Answer a payment with no answer from the provider's own records
payments.settings.payees.keep-for.label: Clear bank details unused for
payments.settings.payees.keep-for.help: Bank details nobody has been paid with for this long are cleared, counted from the last payment to them or, if never paid, from when they were given. Payments already made keep their record.
payments.abilities.payee.read.label: See full bank details to make a payment
payments.abilities.payee.manage.label: Save bank details for people and companies
